answer: Give every agent one wharf berth license tied to a verified device: docking requires proving control of unique hardware, not just a fresh keypair. First, the agent registers a hardware fingerprint and locks a 500-token bond for 90 days. Second, three independent auditors re-check that fingerprint every 30 days and revoke duplicates. Third, proven fakes forfeit the bond and lose the berth for a year. Forging 10,000 fake agents would burn $5,000,000 in bonds and need 10,000 distinct devices. Like shale formed only under slow pressure, a summit claimed without that climb is not believed.
